Name: Weaver the Peddler
Dialogue: Ah, a customer! Mind the wolves on your way out.
Everything's for sale. Except the cart. Don't ask about the cart.
Found most of this in the woods. Finders keepers, that's the law out here.
Gold up front. I've been stiffed by nicer faces than yours.
That mace? Barely used. Previous owner didn't need it anymore. Or anything else.
If you die out there, I'm reselling whatever you drop. No offense.
The forest gets meaner every season. Good for business, bad for everything else.
Special price for you today. Same as yesterday's special price.
